items.question: Can any experience be entirely free from both auspicious and inauspicious qualities?

uncertainties: saṃbhoktaṃ may be read as experienced or to be experienced
items.plain_english: Auspicious and inauspicious things are to be experienced, and nowhere is anything devoid of them.
